resume_bullets: Analyzed 2,700+ public job postings using Python and SQL to identify hiring trends across 61 agencies, 111 job categories, salary ranges, and posting periods.
Cleaned and standardized 20 job-posting attributes, identifying 9 exact duplicates and 0 records with missing salary components while validating dates and salary ranges.
Performed exploratory analysis across 61 agencies and 111 job categories to compare hiring volume, salary distributions, and workforce demand from 2025-09-04 to 2026-08-18.
Built a Power BI-ready reporting model with 5 KPI cards and 6 slicers covering agency, job category, salary band, posting period, experience level, and location.
